## 

```{r}
install.packages("openesm")
```

```{r}
dat <- openesm::get_dataset("0060_beck")$data[, c("id", "day", "hour", "compassionate", "respectful", "finds_fault", "little_sympathy", "starts_arguments", "forgiving", "helpful", "rude", "suspicious", "cold", "polite", "assumes_best")]

head(dat)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

rename(dat, Ag1 = compassionate, Ag2 = respectful, Ag3 = finds_fault, Ag4 = little_sympathy, Ag5 = starts_arguments, Ag6 = forgiving, Ag7 = helpful, Ag8 = rude, Ag9 = suspicious, Ag10 = cold, Ag11 = polite, Ag12 = assumes_best)
```

```{r}
dat %>%
  count(id, name = "n_datapoints")
```

```{r}
write.csv(
  dat,
  file = "Multilevel_Agreeableness.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)
```

pak::pak("marklhc/clustinvar")
